pages.text: $(italic)Iridescent Modular Spells$() takes the standard ISS and Ars Nouveau spell books and adds two configurable slots: $(bold)Cover$() and $(bold)Pages$(). Material installed in each slot grants attribute bonuses (max mana, spell power, mana regen, cooldown reduction) that stack on the base book.$(br2)Caster classes start with a modular Copper book; Archmage also starts with a modular Novice.

pages.title: ISS Tier (metal covers)
pages.text: $(item)Modular Copper$() — T1 entry. Crafted: copper book + leather (default).$(br2)$(item)Modular Iron$() / $(item)Modular Gold$() — T2. iron / gold book + leather.$(br2)$(item)Modular Diamond$() — T3. diamond book + leather.$(br2)$(item)Modular Netherite$() — T4. netherite book + leather.$(br2)$(bold)Cover materials:$() leather (T1), copper, iron, gold, diamond, netherite (T4). Higher tier = bigger bonus.

pages.title: Ars Tier (cloth covers)
pages.text: $(item)Modular Novice$() — T1. novice book + white wool (default).$(br2)$(item)Modular Apprentice$() — T2. apprentice book + white wool.$(br2)$(item)Modular Archmage$() — T3. archmage book + white wool.$(br2)$(bold)Cloth covers:$() $(item)white_wool$() (T1) → $(item)manaweave_cloth$() (T2 Botania) → $(item)sorcerer_robes$() (T3 Ars) → $(item)spell_cloth$() (T4 Botania endgame). Cloth bonuses target Ars max mana + spell damage.

pages.title: Slot bonuses
pages.text: $(bold)Cover$() = 'max' bias: max mana, spell power.$(br)$(bold)Pages$() = 'rate' bias: mana regen, cooldown reduction.$(br2)Bonuses sum across all books you carry — mainhand + offhand + curios. Hold a Diamond book in mainhand and an Apprentice book in curio: the Ars max-mana bump from cloth + the ISS spell-power bump from diamond cover stack on the same player.

pages.title: Custom enchants
pages.text: Modular books accept four book-exclusive enchants on the enchanting table:$(br2)$(item)Mana Capacity$() I-V — +5% max mana per level (both ISS + Ars).$(br)$(item)Mana Flow$() I-III — +5% mana regen per level.$(br)$(item)Arcane Edge$() I-III — +5% magic crit chance per level.$(br)$(item)Arcane Devastation$() I-III — +25% magic crit damage per level.$(br2)$(bold)Yes — magic CAN crit$() with these enchants installed. Vanilla magic doesn't crit, but the modular system adds it via on-hit damage hooks.

pages.title: Tier gates
pages.text: Modular books are tier-gated:$(br)$(item)T1$() — Copper, Novice (start)$(br)$(item)T2$() — Iron, Gold, Apprentice$(br)$(item)T3$() — Diamond, Archmage$(br)$(item)T4$() — Netherite$(br2)Cover/pages materials are gated by their parent material's existing tier (e.g., diamond cover requires T3 stage to obtain diamond at all).
